messages.content:
Acting as a expert Youtube video producer with a knack for SEO, generate a compelling and engaging script for a one-minute video based on the following article summary: {{3.choices[].message.content}}

The script should engage the audience with a compelling introductory hook, provide essential details, cover industry impacts, provide rhetorical questions and end with a clear call to action encouraging interaction through likes, comments, and shares. None of these sections should be made obvious.

The script should be easily readible and only contain the context of the script with no headers, no section names, no notes or labels.  There should be no visual clues or side stage notes in brackets anywhere in the context. An AI voice synthesizer will narrate the script and needs none of your direction in the text.

Negative Prompt: No emojies in content
Create an HD image prompt of 100 words or less, based on the first 25% of this article summary:{{3.choices[].message.content}} Return only the body of prompt.
Create an HD image prompt of 100 words or less, based on the 2nd 25% of this article summary:{{3.choices[].message.content}}Return only the body of the prompt.
Create an HD image prompt of 100 words or less based on the 3rd 25% of this article summary:{{3.choices[].message.content}}Return only the body of the prompt.
Create an HD image prompt of 100 words or less, based on the 4th 25% of this article summary:{{3.choices[].message.content}}Return only the body of the prompt.
Create an HD image prompt of 100 words or less, based on the overall impact of this article summary:{{3.choices[].message.content}}Return only the body of the prompt.
